O kom, låt oss sjunga om Jesus,
0:00 / —
SV AR EN ES FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

O come, let us sing of Jesus, Our precious and faithful Friend, Who went to death for us all, Who loved and still loves us!

2.

For who has given us greater Proof of His love than He, Who through His death for us all Won for us an eternal redemption?

3.

He left the kingdom of heaven And came to our sinful earth To serve, to suffer and bleed, And die according to the Scriptures’ word.

4.

He walked here so poor and lowly, That none so poor here was found, Though He was the Lord of Creation, And heaven and earth were His.

5.

On Golgotha He won the victory, And the enemy’s power is crushed. He triumphantly rose from the grave, And brought forth life in the light.

6.

And when He had completed the work, He ascended to heaven again. Now He is there above with the Father, Our faithful Advocate still.

7.

O Jesus, Thy love we behold In all that Thou didst and dost, A love proved in deed, Just when Thou diest for sinners.

Text: Efter O kom, låt oss sjunga om Jesus, anonym, 1909, bearb. 1955. Musik: O, öppna ditt hjärte för Herran, 1913. 9.8.9.8
